g.text: Terms: AI = artificial intelligence (here, an AI assistant drafting at independence level I0) · BMS = battery management system · ESC = electronic speed controller (drives a UAV motor) · EXT-AIRSPACE =

external element: airspace, people and property under the UAV · EXT-BYSTANDER = external element: bystanders · EXT-CREW = external element: ground crew and maintainers · EXT-GNSS-RF = external element: GNSS

and RF environment · EXT-OBSERVER = external element: safety observer · EXT-PILOT = external element: pilot · EXT-TERRAIN = external element: terrain and obstacles · EXT-WEATHER = external element: weather ·

F-nnn = system function in the item definition · GNSS = global navigation satellite system (GPS and similar) · GPS = Global Positioning System · HAZ-nnn = hazard record (safety/hazards/HAZ-xxx-nnn.yaml) ·

I0–I3 = review independence level (I0 none, e.g. the author or an AI, to I3 independent organisation) · IF-nnn = interface in the item definition (architecture/item-definition.yaml) · IF-PX4-nnn = PX4

integration interface (integrations/px4/interface-contract.md) · PX4 = PX4 Autopilot, the open-source flight-control software candidate for SUS-A1 · RF = radio frequency · SUS-A1 = dockable observation UAV ·

SUS-A1-FC = PX4-based flight controller · SUS-A1-NAV = navigation sensors, camera and telemetry · SUS-A1-PROP = motors, ESCs and propellers · SUS-A1-PWR = UAV battery and power management · SUS-GSE = ground

support, maintenance supports, charging and test equipment · SUS-I1-INT = integration manager and PX4 command adapter · SUS-M1 = piloted walker · SUS-M1-CTL = mission, motion and balance control · SUS-M1-DCK

= UAV dock, retention, charging and release · SUS-M1-MAN = manipulation arms and end effectors · SUS-M1-PIL = pilot station, restraints, displays and controls · SUS-M1-PWR = power generation, storage,
distribution and thermal control · SUS-M1-PWR-BAT = battery pack, BMS and contactors (alternative B) · SUS-M1-PWR-DIST = protected power distribution · SUS-M1-PWR-GEN = engine-generator and governor

(alternative B) · SUS-M1-PWR-HPU = hydraulic power unit, accumulators and isolation (alternative A) · SUS-M1-SAF = independent safety monitor, protective stop and isolation · SUS-M1-WLK = chassis, legs, joint
actuators and stability sensing · UAV = uncrewed aerial vehicle (drone)
